name: Jaswal C2 × C4 genus-one rank 6
description: The first rank-six C2 x C4 family over a positive-rank genus-one base from Jaswal (2026).

provenance.author: Manvir Jaswal
provenance.claim_boundary: The paper proves six independent sections on each genus-one base. This package records the first exact model and base point; no local six-section certificate is declared.
